name: navig-mobile
summary: NAVIG Mobile — pro-grade Android + iOS device operations: connect, device info, apps, file pull, screenshots, backups, plus forensics / spyware-scan / root-jailbreak assist / OSINT, and app UI automation (a11y snapshots, tap/fill, `ui assert` machine checks, evidence capture). Wired into `navig mobile` (+ `navig android` / `navig ios`). A first-party navig plugin (free, toggleable).
